data.one_liner: Flutter animated navigation rail with closing, opening, and custom effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides an animated navigation rail widget with customizable tile configurations, expand and collapse capabilities, and multiple visual effects. It allows managing tabs with items containing icons, labels, and associated screens.
use_when: You need an animated navigation rail for a responsive or desktop/tablet layout.
You want customizable rail items with collapsing and expanding states.
avoid_when: You prefer standard Material NavigationRail without extra third-party animations.
You need deep route integration managed automatically by a router like go_router.
strengths: Supports expanding, collapsing, and custom item builders.
RTL direction support and various cursor options.
Easy to integrate with custom styling via RailTileConfig.
weaknesses: Limited built-in integration with advanced navigation packages.
Lacks customization for custom rail shapes and pointers according to the roadmap.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedRail(
  background: hexToColor('#8B77DD'),
  maxWidth: 275,
  width: 100,
  expand: false,
  isStatic: true,
  items: [
    RailItem(
        icon: Icon(Icons.home),
        label: "Home",
        screen: _buildScreen('Home')),
  ],
)
